findings.text: reading the view is not a pure read, because recovery.recover dispatches a review for every scoring run project-wide (reckon/crew/recovery.py:5315 composes the reflex with no session filter) while the view reports only this session's rows at :185, and the MCP crew view at reckon/mcp.py:3543 (landed as da226e1e after this head) now puts that launch behind a coordinator's inbox read.

the head-keying in _current_review_in_flight is unasserted, because a variant that returns True whenever any live review of the run exists, or that matched only the dead legacy path, keeps all five focused tests green while a live review of an older head would silently suppress a current-head review-missing duty.

_live_review_runs counts only this session's live review pointers, so a review of the run's current head dispatched under another session does not suppress review-missing and the view names a duty that is already underway with a next command admission will refuse.
